description: Airports of Cambodia is a dataset listed in Open Development Mekong data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Open Development Cambodia. This dataset show about the point location of airports both international and national airports in Cambodia. The points also have additional information including attributes (name, type, ICAO and IATA code). The data was extracted from Open Flights database via Environment Operations Centre. Coverage: Cambodia. The portal files it under the publisher Open Development Cambodia. Its tags are Airports and air travel, Infrastructure, Transport and shipping. It offers 5 resource(s) in geojson, jpeg, kml, wms, zip. The portal shows 2020-02-20 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-odm-portal.
